(i) gonadotroph cells in the pituities of male rats represent approximately 14%, (ii) the gonadotropin cell population is heterogeneous in terms of size, (iii) the gonadotropic population is heterogeneous in term of immunostaining, and (iv) the size and the immunostaining of gonadotropic cells are correlated.
gonadotropic cell size and immunostaining intensity are not correlated.
the gonadotropic population in the pituitaries of male rats is heterogeneous in terms of size and staining intensity.

the morphofunctionality of the gonadotrphic cells of the rat pituitary gland.
the quantitative study of the gonadotypic cells of the pituitaries from male rats.
the quantitative study of the population of gonadotropic cells isolated from the pituiary glands of the adult male rats.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the gonadotropic population is heterogeneous and that this heterogeneity is related to the different gonadotropic functions.
the LH and FSH cells are not homogeneous, that they differ in size and that the size of gonadotropic cells varies according to the serum used for immunostaining.
the gonadotrophic cells of the male rat pituitary gland are morphologically heterogeneous.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gonadotropic population is heterogeneous in terms of size, staining intensity and staining serum used.
the gonadotropes in the pituitaries of adult male rats are heterogeneous with respect to size, staining intensity and staining pattern.
gonadotroph population in the male rat pituitary is not a homogeneous population but a heterogeneous population with respect to the number of gonadotropin-producing cells and their size.
The main takeaway from our work is that
gonadotroph heterogeneity is not only related to the gonadotropin content but also to other cell characteristics, such as size.
the size and shape of the gonad cells are important for their function.
the gonadotrope population is not homogeneous and is composed of cells with different morphological characteristics.
